sourceConfidence.notice: Yunnan data was extracted from a published image of the official provincial suitable-flight map rather than original GIS data. Boundaries are approximate and may contain extraction or positional inaccuracies. Check the current official map before flying.

source.authority: Published image of the Yunnan provincial suitable-flight map, vectorized by UAV Companion (not original GIS data)

extraction.method: colour segmentation of the published map image, owner-supplied corrections for label and artefact areas, linear georeferencing to the published Yunnan extent, vectorization
caveats: Purple annotation footprints are treated as flyable restoration.
Orange annotation footprints are forced non-flyable/unknown.
Linear extent georeferencing is approximate; boundary-to-boundary registration remains recommended.
extraction.geojsonNote: Approximate image-derived Yunnan fly-zone geometry; purple user annotations restored as flyable; orange annotations preserved as no-fly/unknown. Not suitable for precise boundary decisions.
